items.prompt: A lazy heap pops (cost=10,u), but current dist[u]=6. What should happen?

options.text: Propagate again using 10 to count a backup route.
options.why: That heap entry no longer represents u's shortest state.

options.text: Restore dist[u]=10 to match the queue entry.
options.why: An obsolete entry must not undo a newer improvement.
Only current-distance pops may propagate the shortest-route count.
Other nodes may still have valid current candidates.

items.explanation: Only current-distance pops may propagate the shortest-route count.
